provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study, not new experimental measurements.
provenance.scope: Results are conditional on the complete stated model, measurement convention and units.

model: One ideal thermoelectric leg has constant alpha,R,K and fixed reservoir temperatures, no contact losses or Thomson term, and symmetric partition of Joule heat. For load ratio m=R_load/R>0, current I=alpha*(Th-Tc)/(R*(1+m)), load power P=I^2*R*m, and absorbed hot heat Qh=alpha*Th*I-I^2*R/2+K*(Th-Tc). Efficiency is P/Qh.
analysis: Globally maximize P and P/Qh separately over all positive m, retaining the same physical parameters. Check heat balance and limiting loads rather than choosing from a coarse grid. K is thermal conductance, not conductivity; no spatial dimensions or actual device performance are inferred.
